bio: A delightful property that stands out for its panoramic views, its setting overlooking the estuary, and its pleasant terraces, perfect for an aperitif or coffee. The cuisine here showcases top-quality products ranging from fresh fish sourced at nearby auctions, such as Bermeo and La Mundaka, and prime cuts of meat, to which you can add different side dishes (don’t miss the beef chop). Many of the dishes served here are cooked on the open grill....
